extracted.name: Best Fluffy Banana Pancake
extracted.description: Two thick, golden pancakes crafted with ripe bananas for a rich, natural sweetness and irresistibly soft texture. Light and airy inside with a delicate golden crust, each pancake is griddled to perfection and served warm for maximum comfort. Enjoy them drizzled with pure maple syrup, topped with fresh banana slices, or finished with a dollop of whipped cream for a truly decadent start to your day.
ingredient_lines: 1 large ripe banana (the riper, the sweeter)
2 tablespoons melted butter or oil (plus more for cooking)
Optional: ½ teaspoon cinnamon or nutmeg for warmth
instruction_lines: In a mixing bowl, mash the ripe banana until smooth with just a few small lumps.
Whisk in the egg, milk, melted butter (or oil), and vanilla until well combined.

In another bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, and cinnamon (if using). Add the dry ingredients to the banana mixture. Gently fold until just combined — don’t overmix; a few lumps are okay.

Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat and lightly grease it. Pour about ¼ cup of batter for each pancake. Cook 2–3 minutes until bubbles form on the surface, then flip and cook another 1–2 minutes until golden. Stack them high and serve with sliced bananas, maple syrup, nuts, or even a sprinkle of chocolate chips.
